summary: This dataset contains whole-transcriptome RNA-seq profiles from 23 human FFPE tumor samples from patients with recurrent resectable stage III or IV melanoma. Samples are annotated by study group and treatment status in a pilot hu14.18-IL2 immunotherapy trial, including tumors resected before or after the first treatment course and two never-treated cases. The study was designed to evaluate tumor and immune biomarkers in resected melanoma tumors in relation to hu14.18-IL2 exposure and clinical follow-up.
title: RNA-seq of recurrent resectable stage III-IV melanoma tumors in a hu14.18-IL2 trial
cancer_type_exact: recurrent resectable stage III and IV melanoma

summary: This GEO series contains RNA-seq profiles from 28 melanoma biopsy samples collected from patients receiving pembrolizumab, with anti-PD-1 response and clinical annotations. The cohort is predominantly composed of pre-treatment biopsies, and includes one on-treatment biopsy as well as two pretreatment biopsies from one patient. The dataset was generated to study transcriptomic features associated with response and non-response to anti-PD-1 checkpoint blockade in melanoma.
title: RNA-seq melanoma biopsies for anti-PD-1 response

summary: This dataset contains RNA-seq profiles from 19 human pancreatic tumor samples from patients with pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, including 10 short-term and 9 long-term survivors. Libraries were prepared from total RNA from tumor tissue and sequenced for transcriptome-wide expression profiling of coding transcripts. The study was designed to compare transcriptomic differences between PDAC survival groups and support integrative group- and individual-level network analyses.
title: RNA-seq of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma tumors by survival group

summary: This dataset contains RNA-seq profiles from 30 human hepatocellular carcinoma tumor samples collected at Tongji Hospital. All samples are untreated tumor specimens obtained at radical resection and analyzed by high-throughput transcriptome sequencing. The cohort was generated to study the hypoxic microenvironment in hepatocellular carcinoma and support hypoxia-related prognostic and tumor microenvironment analyses.
title: RNA-seq of hepatocellular carcinoma tumors from the Tongji cohort

summary: This series contains bulk RNA-seq profiles from FFPE human glioma specimens spanning low-grade and high-grade disease, including tumors collected at diagnosis and after malignant progression. Some cases include matched pairs of the original low-grade tumor and the subsequent high-grade tumor. The deposited dataset was generated to study malignant progression in glioma and includes clinical and molecular annotations.
title: Bulk RNA-seq of malignant progression in glioma

summary: This series contains bulk RNA-seq profiles from 81 primary non-small cell lung cancer tumors, 19 adjacent lung tissues, and 4 lung cancer cell line samples (A549 and CL1-0) with FUT4 overexpression or vector control. The tumor cohort includes adenocarcinoma and squamous cell carcinoma cases with clinical annotations. The dataset was generated to study transcriptomic changes associated with FUT4 and its relation to prognosis and signaling in lung cancer.
title: RNA-seq of non-small cell lung cancer tissues and FUT4-overexpressing lung cancer cell lines

summary: This bulk RNA-seq series comprises 62 malignant liver tumor samples from a Korean hepatocellular carcinoma cohort, together with 47 premalignant liver lesions and 15 normal liver samples; replicate libraries are also included in the deposited series. The dataset was generated by high-throughput RNA sequencing to profile the preoperative immune landscape across premalignant and malignant liver stages in patients undergoing total or partial hepatectomy.
title: Bulk RNA-seq of hepatocellular carcinoma and premalignant liver lesions

summary: This dataset comprises RNA-seq profiles from 63 TFE3-translocation renal cell carcinoma tumor samples and 14 adjacent normal tissue samples. Libraries were generated from FFPE total RNA and sequenced as stranded paired-end transcriptomes. The study was designed to characterize the transcriptomic features of TFE3-translocation renal cell carcinoma, with sample-level clinical annotations including stage and survival variables.
title: RNA-seq of TFE3-translocation renal cell carcinoma and adjacent normal tissue

summary: This series contains poly(A) RNA-seq expression profiles for 3,273 primary breast tumors from the population-based multicenter SCAN-B cohort, together with 136 technical replicates. The deposited data provide gene- and transcript-level expression estimates, PAM50 subtype assignments, and RNA-seq-based predictions for ER, PgR, HER2, Ki67, and Nottingham histologic grade in the validation cohort. The dataset was generated to support evaluation of RNA-seq classifiers for conventional breast cancer biomarkers in a prospective clinical study setting.
title: RNA-seq of 3273 SCAN-B breast tumors

summary: This GEO Series contains RNA-seq mRNA expression profiles from 51 primary high-grade serous ovarian carcinoma tumor samples from human patients. The cohort includes samples across stages I-IV with sample-level clinical annotations such as platinum therapy response, recurrence status, and survival. The dataset was generated to characterize the transcriptome of HGSC in the context of prognosis and conventional treatment response.
title: RNA-seq of high-grade serous ovarian carcinoma with clinical outcome annotations

summary: This dataset comprises bulk RNA-seq profiles from 97 human primary neuroblastoma tumors. Samples span tumor stages 1, 2, 3, 4, and 4S and include MYCN amplification status annotations. The expression data were generated to characterize neuroblastoma transcriptional programs in the context of IGF2BP1 and MYCN-associated disease biology.
title: RNA-seq of primary neuroblastoma tumors

summary: This GEO series contains RNA-seq profiles from human tumors from children aged ≥18 months with INSS stage 3, MYCN-non-amplified, unfavorable-histology neuroblastoma, including neuroblastoma and ganglioneuroblastoma, nodular specimens. The deposited data are transcriptome sequencing counts generated from tumor RNA, with sample-level clinical outcome annotations. The dataset was generated to evaluate associations between tumor gene expression patterns and clinical outcome in this clinically defined neuroblastoma cohort.
title: RNA-seq of stage 3 MYCN-non-amplified unfavorable-histology neuroblastoma
cancer_type_exact: INSS stage 3 MYCN-non-amplified unfavorable histology neuroblastoma

summary: This GEO series contains RNA-seq gene expression profiles from 25 stage IV melanoma tumor biopsies collected before tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte-based adoptive T-cell therapy in a clinical phase I/II trial. The cohort consists of patients previously treated with other immunotherapies, with clinical response and survival annotations available. The deposited data are processed transcriptomic profiles generated on an Illumina HiSeq 2000 to study tumor expression features associated with clinical benefit from ACT.
title: RNA-seq stage IV melanoma before adoptive T-cell therapy

summary: This GEO series contains bulk RNA-seq profiles of 81 primary purified circulating tumor cell-enriched blood samples, including 42 samples from patients with localized PDAC, 18 from patients with metastatic PDAC, and 21 healthy donor controls. Sequencing was performed on CTC-iChip-purified samples to generate transcriptome-wide expression profiles. The dataset was generated to characterize circulating tumor cell-associated transcriptional programs in pancreatic cancer in the context of metastasis-related biology.
title: RNA-seq of PDAC circulating tumor cells

summary: This GEO series provides bulk RNA-seq profiles for 47 human brain metastatic tissue samples resected from patients with solid tumors. The deposited assay is RNA sequencing, with gene-level expression files and sample annotations including age, sex, survival, and prognostic subtype. The dataset was generated to investigate transcriptomic subtypes and clinical outcomes of brain metastasis following craniotomy and associated local therapies.
title: RNA-seq of brain metastases from solid tumors

summary: This GEO series contains targeted RNA-seq expression profiles for a 72-gene panel generated from 483 FFPE breast cancer solid tumor samples collected at Shanghai Cancer Hospital and UNC-Chapel Hill. Sample metadata include RNA-based ER/PR status and iRDM/PAM50 subtype, immunity, and proliferation group annotations, and a subset of 303 samples has distant metastasis-free survival data. The dataset was generated to assess prognostic immunity markers and to support breast cancer subtype classification and risk stratification using the iRDM model.
title: 72-gene targeted RNA-seq of breast cancer FFPE tumors

summary: This GEO series contains RNA-seq profiles from 61 human FFPE lung tumor tissue samples. Sample annotations indicate a mixed lung cancer cohort composed mainly of adenocarcinoma and squamous cell carcinoma, with additional mixed-histology and neuroendocrine cases. The dataset was generated to provide transcriptomic profiling of lung cancer tissues.
title: RNA-seq of lung cancer FFPE tissue samples

summary: This dataset contains RNA-seq expression profiles from 57 bladder cancer tissues and 13 normal bladder tissues collected at Xiangya Hospital. Libraries were prepared from total RNA and sequenced for transcriptome-wide expression profiling, with reads aligned to GRCh38 and quantified for gene-level expression. The deposited cohort supports comparative transcriptomic analysis of bladder cancer versus normal bladder tissue.
title: RNA-seq of bladder cancer and normal bladder tissues

summary: This dataset contains RNA-seq profiles for 89 samples from 89 patients with colorectal cancer, including 66 cases annotated as stage IV. mRNA purified from formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded blocks was sequenced on the Illumina HiSeq 4000, with gene-level count and TPM files provided for each sample. The cohort was generated for transcriptome profiling of colorectal cancer with a focus on advanced disease and related clinical outcome annotations.
title: RNA-seq colorectal cancer FFPE cohort

summary: This bulk RNA-seq dataset comprises 105 human melanoma tumor samples, including acral and sun-exposed melanomas from the Yale and CSU cohorts. The cohort contains primary and metastatic tumors with subtype and clinical annotations. The dataset was generated to characterize transcriptomic features of acral melanoma in comparison with sun-exposed melanoma.
title: RNA-seq acral and sun-exposed melanoma tumors

summary: This GEO series contains targeted RNA expression profiles from 21 pretreatment tumor samples from patients with non-small cell lung cancer who received single-agent anti-PD-1 immunotherapy. Expression was measured using the Oncomine Immune Response Research Assay, a targeted panel of immune-related genes. The cohort includes cases with durable clinical benefit and non-durable benefit, enabling analysis of tumor immune signatures associated with response to PD-1 blockade.
title: Targeted RNA-seq of NSCLC before anti-PD-1 therapy

summary: This GEO series contains bulk polyA RNA-seq profiles from 19 tumor biopsy samples from patients with stage IV/metastatic triple-negative breast cancer enrolled in a single-arm phase II trial of carboplatin, nab-paclitaxel, and pembrolizumab. The samples include pretreatment biopsies from primary breast and metastatic sites, with four additional post-treatment metastatic biopsies. The dataset was generated to examine transcriptomic patterns in relation to radiographic response and clinical outcomes in this treated cohort.
title: RNA-seq of metastatic triple-negative breast cancer biopsies from a carboplatin/nab-paclitaxel/pembrolizumab phase II trial

summary: This dataset comprises RNA-seq profiles from 81 pretreatment bone marrow samples from patients with newly diagnosed acute myeloid leukemia. Total RNA from bone marrow mononuclear cells was sequenced to generate gene-level expression counts for assessment of AML transcriptomic patterns and lineage-independent inflammatory and metabolic signatures associated with outcomes.
title: RNA-seq of pretreatment acute myeloid leukemia bone marrow

summary: This GEO series contains bulk RNA-seq profiles from 17 metastatic brain tumor tissue samples annotated as metastatic melanoma. Libraries were generated from total RNA using transcriptome capture and sequenced on the Illumina HiSeq 2500 for expression profiling. The dataset was generated to compare gene expression between groups defined by the timing of immunotherapy relative to radiation therapy, with survival status and follow-up time provided in the sample metadata.
title: RNA-seq of melanoma brain metastases by RT/immunotherapy timing

summary: This GEO series contains bulk RNA-seq profiles from 37 tumor samples from patients with locally advanced esophageal and gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma treated with adjuvant durvalumab in a phase II study. RNA was extracted from FFPE tumor blocks and profiled by RNA-seq, with supplementary gene-level FPKM values and clinical data including CIBERSORTx immune deconvolution output. The dataset was generated for correlative analysis of the tumor immune microenvironment in the setting of adjuvant durvalumab following trimodality therapy.
title: RNA-seq of locally advanced esophageal and GEJ adenocarcinoma in an adjuvant durvalumab trial
cancer_type_exact: locally advanced esophageal and gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma

summary: This dataset contains RNA-seq expression profiles from 54 frozen lung tissue samples comprising 27 paired lung adenocarcinoma tumors and matched normal lung tissues from never-smokers. Samples include clinical annotations such as stage, histologic differentiation, survival status, and follow-up time. The series is the RNA-seq component of a paired tumor-normal study examining pathway deregulation and clinical outcomes in never-smoker lung adenocarcinoma.
title: RNA-seq of never-smoker lung adenocarcinoma tumors and matched normal lung

summary: This dataset comprises RNA-seq profiles from 246 samples representing 123 paired lung adenocarcinoma tumors and tumor-adjacent normal lung tissues. Sample metadata include clinical outcome annotations such as no progression, locoregional recurrence, systemic recurrence, second primary, and short follow-up. The dataset was generated to compare tumor and adjacent normal lung transcriptomes in relation to clinical outcome in lung adenocarcinoma.
title: Paired RNA-seq of lung adenocarcinoma tumors and adjacent normal lung

summary: This dataset contains RNA-seq profiles from 79 human small cell lung cancer tumor samples and 7 normal lung control samples. Total RNA libraries were sequenced for expression profiling on an Illumina HiSeq 2000, and normalized expression data are provided. The study was deposited to support transcriptomic characterization of small cell lung cancer and differential expression analysis in the context of SRSF1-associated biology.
title: RNA-seq of small cell lung cancer tumors and normal lung controls

summary: This GEO series contains RNA-seq profiles from FFPE prostate tumor specimens from Hispanic/Latino patients, predominantly radical prostatectomy cases, with ERG-status and clinical annotations including biochemical recurrence, Gleason grade, and clinical stage. The deposited transcriptomic data were generated to compare ERG-high and ERG-low tumors in prostate cancer and to study their relationship to biochemical recurrence.
title: Prostate cancer FFPE RNA-seq by ERG status

summary: This dataset contains RNA-seq profiles from 85 primary tumor samples from previously untreated high-grade serous carcinoma cases, including tumors with and without associated serous tubal intra-epithelial carcinoma (STIC) lesions. Samples are annotated for STIC status and clinical features. The study was designed to compare tumor transcriptomic profiles by STIC association in a multicenter pelvic HGSC cohort.
title: RNA-seq pelvic high-grade serous carcinoma with and without STIC

summary: This dataset contains bulk RNA-seq profiles from 175 human pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma patient tumors collected across UMD and German cohorts. Samples are annotated for molecular subtype, including classical, basal, and unclassified groups, with SERPINB3 high/low status and clinical outcome variables. The transcriptome data were generated by high-throughput sequencing to study molecular signatures associated with the aggressive basal-like/squamous PDAC context and SERPINB3 expression.
title: RNA-seq of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma tumors by molecular subtype

summary: This dataset contains miRNA-seq profiles from 64 liver tissue samples comprising tumors and matched adjacent tissue from 32 patients with hepatocellular carcinoma. Libraries were prepared from total RNA and sequenced on the BGISEQ-500 platform for small RNA profiling. The study was designed to characterize miRNA expression differences in hepatocellular carcinoma and support evaluation of candidate prognostic biomarkers.
title: miRNA-seq of hepatocellular carcinoma tumors and matched adjacent liver tissue

summary: This dataset comprises bulk RNA-seq profiles from 52 human bladder cancer tissue samples. Samples are annotated with TP53 signature score and group, TP53 mutation status, survival, and other clinical variables. The deposited expression data were generated to support analysis of TP53-related signatures in bladder cancer prognosis and tumor microenvironment characteristics.
title: RNA-seq bladder cancer cohort with TP53 signature annotations
